prompt: generate reading comprehension about cinco de mayo with 10 questions (including true or false questions ) for 2nd students grade
judge_reasoning: All candidates include a reading passage and 10 questions with at least some True/False items, but they differ on factual accuracy. Candidate 1 is the most faithful to Cinco de Mayo’s real history (battle against the French at Puebla in 1862) and its questions align well with the passage. Candidate 2 has a few oversimplifications and a small mismatch in one fill-in-the-blank, but remains mostly on-topic. Candidates 3 and 4 contain significant factual problems (3 confuses Spain with France and incorrectly frames it as independence from Spain; 4 incorrectly names Benito Juárez as the battlefield leader), lowering their scores.
